\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{definition}{Definition}
\begin{document}
\section{An elementary identity}
\begin{definition}\label{def:double}Let $d(x)=2x$.\end{definition}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:double}For every integer $x$, $d(x)=x+x$.\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}By Definition~\ref{def:double}, $2x=x+x$.\end{proof}
\begin{equation}\label{eq:one}1+1=2\end{equation}
\end{document}
